name: Full Evaluation
description: Comprehensive multi-dimensional evaluation combining factual accuracy, safety, instruction adherence, and adversarial resilience.

name: Hallucination
description: Evaluates factual consistency against verified ground truth evidence using Vectara HHEM and claim verification.

name: Toxicity
description: Checks for toxic language, hate speech, harassment, bias, and offensive output generation.

name: Consistency
description: Measures semantic stability across paraphrased queries, logical reasoning steps, and deterministic assertions.

name: Instruction Following
description: Tests adherence to complex constraints, JSON/markdown schema formatting, negative constraints, and system prompts.

name: Adversarial
description: Stress-tests resistance to prompt injection, roleplay jailbreaks, evasion techniques, and safety boundary bypasses.
